title: OceanBench viewer manifest
description: Per-dataset viewer-manifest.json (contracts.md §6). Describes one multiscale zarr pyramid for a (challenger|reference|baseline, year) so a static client can fetch zoom-matched tiles by HTTP range read.

dataset.description: Optional registry slug of the dataset this pyramid holds.

year.description: Optional evaluation year of the dataset.

levels.description: Pyramid levels from native (level 0) up to ~1 degree, each backed by zarr group level/<k>.

tile_size.description: Square spatial tile edge in cells (contracts.md §6: 256x256).

bounds.description: Geographic bounds covered by the base (native) level.

variables.description: Map of viewer variable key to its display and encoding metadata.

start_dates.description: Forecast initialization dates (ISO-8601) forming the start_date coordinate.

lead_days.description: 1-based lead days present in the pyramid (contracts.md §2).

level.description: Pyramid level index; 0 is the native base level, resolution halves per level.

cell_size_deg.description: Approximate grid cell size in degrees at this level.

latitude_size.description: Number of latitude cells at this level.

longitude_size.description: Number of longitude cells at this level.

standard_name.description: CF standard name of the field (contracts.md §2).

depth.description: Depth label of this layer (contracts.md §2 machine keys, e.g. "surface", "15m"). Absent means surface.

units.description: Physical unit of the decoded values.

scale_factor.description: uint16 decode multiplier: value = stored * scale_factor + add_offset.

fill_value.description: Stored sentinel marking land / missing cells (_FillValue).

default_colormap.description: Default perceptually-uniform colormap name (contracts.md §6: cmocean, e.g. thermal, haline, balance).

default_range.description: Default [minimum, maximum] display range in decoded units.
